function.description: Checks Cisco ISE server integration workflow status. This reports integration progress, completion, failures, and integration step status only. It does not return the configured ISE server state; configured ISE server state belongs to Authentication and Policy Server inventory.
function.name: api_ciscoISEServerIntegrationStatus

overallErrorMessage.description: Cisco ISE Server integration failure message

overallStatus.description: Cisco ISE server integration workflow status. This is not the configured ISE server state.

certAcceptedByUser.description: If user accept Cisco ISE Server certificate, value will be true otherwise it will be false

stepId.description: Cisco ISE Server integration step identifier (E.g. 1)

stepName.description: Cisco ISE Server integration step name

stepOrder.description: Cisco ISE Server integration step order (E.g. 1)

stepStatus.description: Cisco ISE Server integration step status

stepTime.description: Last updated epoc time  by the step (E.g. 1677745739314)
